disconfirmation.strongest_evidence_against: Evidence that this process rule contradicted a user-controlled workflow, forced unsafe automation, or was later reverted because direct-to-main changes were required.

disconfirmation.effect: Acceptable process choice; not a product/runtime authority.

rows.atomic_decision: The user creates the Pull Request after Codex branch work.

disconfirmation.strongest_evidence_against: Evidence that Codex was required to create PRs for correctness or that assigning PR creation to the user caused a technical/project-state defect.
disconfirmation.contrary_found: No such evidence was found. PR creation is an actor/process allocation, not a product mechanism.
disconfirmation.effect: Acceptable process choice with no demonstrated technical defect.

disconfirmation.strongest_evidence_against: Evidence that this actor boundary conflicted with required automation or prevented a necessary repository operation.

disconfirmation.effect: Acceptable process choice; no correction chain establishes it as defective.
